mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.2% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the last 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the last 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing supply chain disruption (INDPRO below 102.0), production bottlenecks reduce corporate profit margins and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 102.0.

mechanism_narrative: A higher quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 is above 23000.0 (annualized).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a rapidly deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the last 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the last 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS above 5.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy rate hikes increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.
